text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: PREDICTED, not measured. No patient tissue, and no tissue of any kind, is behind these tracks.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: REF and ALT share the exact y scale within each track; Δ = ALT − REF has its own symmetric lane with zero visible.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Tracks were frozen before the call was repeated; the split from the supplement is by modality, not appearance. · largest |Δ| in any bin shown here: 0.25
